newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK REVOKES SLOVAK EKOAGROBANKA LICENCE.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK REVOKES SLOVAK EKOAGROBANKA LICENCE.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Sunday said it had revoked the banking licence of the Slovak branch of troubled Czech bank Ekoagrobanka .

"The (NBS) department of banking supervision decided to withdraw the banking licence of the Piestany-based Slovak branch of Czech Ekoagrobanka a.s., effective September 21," the NBS said in a statement after the meeting of its governing board.

The move was based mainly on a decision by the Czech National Bank (CNB) to put the Czech Ekoagrobanka under forced administration, and on failure to show positive results of the recovering process in the bank as such, the statement said.
The NBS put Ekoagrobanka's Slovak branch under forced administration in January this year, following a similar move by the CNB over the Czech parent bank.
On September 13, the NBS banned the Ekoagrobanka's Slovak unit from accepting deposits and from receiving loans, and initiated the process of revoking the branch's licence.

The move had been based on the deteriorating situation in the Slovak branch after Ekoagrobanka entered the central bank's forced administration, as well as its failure to adhere to the conditions set out in its banking licence.
